subject: Interim SOC 2 acceptance for renewal — audit period coverage & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Jake Sullivan <jake.sullivan@blueline.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Counsel <legal@blueline.com>, BlueLine Procurement <procurement@blueline.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + interim coverage for renewal (action: confirm by 2027-09-22)

Hi Irene,

We’re kicking off our renewal procurement for BlueLine’s platform contracts and need to confirm Redwood’s audit coverage for the period our security review covers. Procurement has asked for the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a letter covering any gap between that report’s last test date and our renewal effective date (Oct 1).

Specific asks (procurement checklist attached):
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- A signed letter confirming continued controls coverage (they called it a “bridge letter”) or an equivalent interim attestation
- Completed CAIQ and SIG responses for our records
- Timeline: confirmation by 2027-09-22 to keep our renewal on track

Can you confirm what Redwood can provide and whether BlueLine will accept an interim attestation + completed CAIQ/SIG in lieu of a specific bridge format?

Thanks,
Jake Sullivan
Senior Sourcing Manager
BlueLine Systems

Attachment: blueline-procurement-evidence-request.pdf
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jake Sullivan <jake.sullivan@blueline.com>, BlueLine Procurement <procurement@blueline.com>
Cc: Legal Counsel <legal@blueline.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + interim coverage for renewal (action: confirm by 2027-09-22)

Hi Jake — thanks for the clear checklist. We can support BlueLine’s renewal but need to clarify expectations so we provide the right artifacts. Short answers up front:
- We will provide the last SOC 2 Type II report (June 2027) and a signed interim acceptance letter from Redwood’s compliance team documenting control coverage through Sept 30, 2027.
- We will deliver a completed CAIQ and SIG export and a control-mapping matrix that ties SOC 2 tests to CAIQ/SIG items.

A couple of clarifying questions for procurement:
1) Is a signed interim acceptance letter + the SOC 2 report + CAIQ/SIG acceptable, or do you require a specific phraseology for the letter (your note used “bridge letter”)?
2) Do you need DocuSign for the attestation or is a PDF signed by our Director of Compliance sufficient?

Internal note: looping in Priyom (evidence owner) and Marissa (SOC 2 report access). Dev — can you prep a DocuSign template if needed and confirm expected turnaround?

If procurement confirms the interim approach we’ll target delivery by 2027-09-22. Happy to set a quick call if you want to walk the mapping together.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-soc2-type2-202706.pdf (will deliver)
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-17T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts and interim attestation — our plan

Thanks for the ping — scope and availability below. I recommend we avoid the term "bridge letter" (procurement teams read that as an audit gap admission) and instead provide an "Interim Acceptance Letter" that:
- States the period covered by the last SOC 2 Type II (tests performed through 2027-06-30)
- Affirms that key control families (Access, Change Mgmt, Logging/Monitoring, Encryption at Rest) remained in place and highlights any material changes (none since the last audit)
- Includes a short attachments list and reference to the control-mapping worksheet

Available artifacts and ETA: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (redwood-soc2-type2-202706.pdf) — ready
- Control-mapping matrix (SOC2->CAIQ/SIG) — will finish 2027-09-18
- Completed CAIQ export and SIG pack — will finish 2027-09-18
- Interim Acceptance Letter (we will populate from template and get Compliance sign-off) — draft 2027-09-18, signed copy 2027-09-19 (DocuSign if procurement requires it)

Dev: I can send you the final PDF pack and the DocuSign template by EOD 9/18. Marissa: can you confirm there are no outstanding findings that need callouts in the letter?

If procurement requires additional artifacts (KMS attestation, CT logs, backup reports), I can include excerpts but prefer to keep the initial packet concise and flag a route for follow-up items.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Compliance Manager (Evidence)

Attachment: interim-acceptance-letter-template.pdf (working draft)
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jake Sullivan <jake.sullivan@blueline.com>, BlueLine Procurement <procurement@blueline.com>
Cc: Legal Counsel <legal@blueline.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-20T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + interim coverage for renewal — artifacts committed

Hi Jake — following internal review we can confirm the following deliverables for BlueLine’s renewal:

Deliverables (to be uploaded to your secure portal / delivered via DocuSign):
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (tests through 2027-06-30) — redwood-soc2-type2-202706.pdf
- Signed Interim Acceptance Letter (attestation of control coverage through 2027-09-30) — will be signed by our Director, Security & Compliance and sent via DocuSign if you require it
- Completed CAIQ export and SIG pack, plus a SOC2->CAIQ/SIG control-mapping matrix
- Procurement evidence checklist (procurement-evidence-checklist.xlsx) populated per your template

Timeline: signed interim acceptance letter and the full evidence packet will be delivered by 2027-09-22. If your legal/procurement team requires specific language in the attestation, please send a short example; otherwise we’ll use our standard interim template (attached).

If helpful, we can do a 20-minute call on 2027-09-23 to walk through the mapping and confirm acceptance. Please confirm receipt and whether DocuSign is preferred for the attestation.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-type2-202706.pdf, interim-acceptance-letter-template.pdf, procurement-evidence-checklist.xlsx
